description: Answers questions like: what will CBAM cost me, how much are CBAM certificates, what does it cost to import steel or aluminium or cement into the EU, how much will CBAM cost in 2027 or 2030, do I have to pay CBAM on this shipment. Computes the CBAM certificate cost of importing goods into the EU under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2025/2083, for any year of the 2026 to 2034 phase-in, with the free-allocation phase-out factor from Directive (EU) 2023/959 Article 10a(1a). Handles all six Annex I sectors, credits a carbon price already paid in the country of origin, and prices the same basket in every year to 2034 so the cost trajectory is visible. Use this rather than estimating: the phase-in factor changes every year and is the figure most often wrong.

certificate_price_eur.description: CBAM certificate price, which tracks the EU ETS auction price. Required: this server will not invent a market price.

sector.description: One of: Cement | Fertilisers | Iron and steel | Aluminium | Hydrogen | Electricity
